rows.title: Restore the machine to a known state
rows.settles: Nothing. It puts the machine back so the next test starts from a known state.

rows.title: One-shot reconnect on the A2DP filter, protection on then off
rows.settles: Whether the Handsfree assisted connect fallback is needed, and whether the 15 s connect budget holds.

rows.title: One-shot disconnect per filter, and whether a block alone drops the link
rows.settles: Whether the 12 s disconnect budget holds, whether one filter drops the whole link, and whether a block alone disconnects.

rows.title: Whether an allow alone pages the AirPods
rows.settles: Whether enabling the nodes can take the AirPods off the phone with no connect request, which decides if Block at boot off needs a warning and whether the connect path can be shortened.

rows.title: Block, restart, and read the nodes again
rows.settles: Whether CM_DISABLE_PERSIST really holds across a restart, which is what the boot block depends on.

rows.title: Allow the nodes and watch the endpoints return
rows.settles: Whether the allow clears the persistent disable, and whether ten seconds is long enough for the render endpoint to come back.

rows.title: Handsfree protection, unelevated and through the gate
rows.settles: Whether an unelevated fast path is possible in v1.1, what Headset returns on these AirPods, and how long the SYSTEM call takes against the five minute task limit.

rows.title: Non-elevated RunEx of the SYSTEM tasks, and plan B
rows.settles: Whether the tray can start the elevated tasks at all, how Task Scheduler passes the arguments, and whether the --principal user plan B is needed.

rows.title: Acceptance: full power cycle in the shipping configuration
rows.settles: The single acceptance test for v1: after a full power cycle the AirPods stay connected to the phone.

rows.title: Shutdown while connected, then the next boot
rows.settles: Whether the v1.1 pre-shutdown service is needed, by showing what happens when the machine is shut down with the nodes still enabled.

rows.title: End-session messages, one variant per run
rows.settles: Which end-session messages Earshot actually receives for each kind of restart, and whether the block it queues at that moment ever finishes.

rows.title: Battery sweep, disconnected and connected
rows.settles: The leg of the phase 0 battery question that was never run: whether any battery property returns a value while the AirPods are disconnected from this PC.

rows.title: Notification thread, apartment and event order
rows.settles: Which thread and apartment Core Audio calls back on during a connect, a disconnect and a protection change, and how many notifications one change produces.

rows.title: Tuning the idle grace window
rows.settles: Whether the idle grace Earshot uses is the right wait before the nodes are blocked again, measured against real driver churn.

rows.title: The gate refuses to pin a phone
rows.settles: That the pin can never be moved to a device with no A2DP sink, so a phone can never be the device Earshot disables.

rows.title: Uninstall reverses everything, then install sets it up again
rows.settles: Whether uninstall really restores the nodes, the services, the tasks and the folders, and whether install from a release folder passes its own checks.
